phase_quantization_rule: round-to-nearest multiple of 2*pi/2^bits (numpy round-half-even), range [-pi, pi), ordering/length/parity preserved, no refitting

sparsity_extension.support_rule: deterministic global largest-|value| entries of H_original, ties broken by row-major index; independent of any solved output
sparsity_extension.scope: classical Ridge references, matrix errors, wrapper block-encoding validation and resources with exact values; no per-support QSVT phase synthesis

failure_policy: failed configurations are retained in every registry and never replaced
